supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Moderate lateral extension visible posterior to the eye margin

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the light-toned (pinkish/tan) muzzle area and the dark-toned (black/grey) cheek and periocular regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Moderate vertical thickness of the lower lip with a distinct structural droop

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white pilosity (beard) on the chin and lower muzzle region
